messages:
infra-bot: Pager: severity=page service=redwood-runtime job=tp4-infer-4567 detected NCCL collective stall on 3 pods. link=https://pager.redwood/incident/5078901111
oncall-amber: joining bridge. starting quick triage: fetching logs and `nvidia-smi -q`.
sre-liam: on bridge. seeing repeated `NCCL WARN` and `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS` in runtime logs. marking node-12 for cordon.
eng-ml-sara: if this is a collective rendezvous hang, quick mitigation is to reduce shard batch and force single-replica fallback. also check driver versions (`nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv`).
oncall-amber: cordoned node-12 and draining: `kubectl drain node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
sre-liam: drain complete, pods rescheduled. observed OOM/KILL on tp4-worker-2 before drain. kernel log excerpt:
```
[12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, PID=7890
[12345.678905] python3[7890]: Fatal: CUDA error: illegal memory access
```
eng-ml-sara: Xid=79 historically tied to driver or thermal issues on these hosts. applying mitigation: set `--max-batch-tokens=512` and force `replicas=1` for this job to reduce memory pressure.
support-maria: any visible customer impact? I see an uptick in 502s for customer xyz in monitoring.
oncall-amber: impact window ~12:04-12:12 UTC, error rate peaked ~1.2% requests to /inference/v1. Logged in incident timeline. Will notify account team.
infra-bot: Bridge created: https://zoom/bridge/5078901111. Escalation owner: oncall-amber.
sre-liam: restarting gpu-driver daemonset on node-12 to ensure driver + kernel modules reload. will reprovision if mismatch persists.
eng-ml-sara: applied batch limit + single-GPU fallback, traffic rerouted away from stalled shards. error rate returning to baseline; continuing to monitor for regressions.
oncall-amber: collecting logs for postmortem. tagging `customers-xyz` and drafting comms. good triage on Xid79. :thumbsup:
support-maria: pinging customer with interim status and ETA for full RCA.
eng-ml-sara: NCCL debug snippet saved:
```
NCCL INFO Comm 0x7f8abcd init rank 0/3
NCCL WARN Allreduce op rank 2 timed out after 120s
NCCL ERROR socket connect: Resource temporarily unavailable
```
sre-liam: follow-ups: add kernel/driver compatibility probe to node bootstrap, add thermal telemetry alerting and a circuit breaker to TP job autoscale. filing follow-up tickets.
oncall-amber: closing pager for now — mitigation in place, customer notified, follow-ups assigned. moving to postmortem draft.
_meta: generated for dataset: incident coordination thread about NCCL/multi-GPU hang, includes bot paging, on-call handoff, mitigation steps, customer impact
